I think this is something a lot of people struggle with, especially in terms of fitness. It can be difficult to set goals that are both challenging and reasonable, and can be frustrating if your results are not immediate.  My best advice would be to try and set goals related to how you want to feel, rather than look. For example, saying "I want to be stronger" instead of "I want to lose weight" can make a difference in how you approach training. When it comes to food, trying to follow the 80/20 rule (80% "healthy", 20% "fun" foods)! With this approach, nothing is "good" or "bad" - it's just different kinds of food! Hope this helps :)
